stops.title: Mɛmba Lis ɛn Rota
stops.caption: Udat de sav, ɛn we tɛm.
stops.speech: Wan dipatmɛnt de kip lis fɔ udat de sav pan am ɛn rota fɔ udat de sav we tɛm, put awt fyu wik bifo.

stops.title: Rikrutmɛnt
stops.caption: Aplay, intavyu, trayal.
stops.speech: Rikrutmɛnt de ron frɔm apliksheɔn tru intavyu ɛn ɔfa go na trayal tɛm, wit ɛvri kandidet we yu kin si na dɛn stej.
